servtuner plan's input (Planner inputs): the traffic to plan for, the SLO, availability and overrides. The capacity models are passed beside it.

Schema file: `schema/json/plan-request.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `ea52778da279`.

## Top level

| Field              | Type              | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `peak_rps`         | `number`          | Yes      | &gt; 0                                                                                                                                                                |
| `baseline_rps`     | `number`          | No       | Off-peak traffic, for the HPA minimum. Without it, the minimum is the availability floor. &gt; 0                                                                      |
| `slos`             | `object`          | Yes      | The SLO to plan for. It need not be the one the runs used: the per-replica capacity is recomputed from the stored curves, interpolating only between measured stages. |
| `workload_hash`    | `string`          | No       | Plan only models measured with this request mix; required when the models disagree. pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`                                                          |
| `availability`     | `object`          | No       |                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `replica_headroom` | `number`          | No       | ≥ 0; &lt; 1 Default: `0.2`.                                                                                                                                           |
| `burst_factor`     | `number`          | No       | ≥ 1 Default: `1`.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `overrides`        | array of `object` | No       | Scenario overrides on the plan's derivation nodes.                                                                                                                    |

## Definitions

### overrideKind

Named apart from the recommendations' subject kind: two generated enums both called Kind collided in the api's OpenAPI document.
